holder-quote: They didn’t run. Eldertuin the Fortress planted his shield and bellowed a counter-command.
effect-quote: A pale, sage-green shield burst from his shield. It traced a teardrop shape—as wide as the street. The spells and Draugr hit it and—bounced.

holder-quote: It was Eldertuin the Fortress who lifted his mace and shield.
effect-quote: Eldertuin raised his shield as he charged.
